On-Campus Graduate Programs
Begin Your Graduate Journey at the University of Miami
Join our innovative community of scholars, practitioners, and leaders. One online application opens the door to most of our on-campus master's, doctoral, and certificate programs.
Apply Now → Explore Programs
Your Path to Applying
Four steps from curious to Cane.
1
Explore
Browse our full list of graduate degrees and certificates to find your fit.
View programs →
2
Connect
Reach out to the admissions representative for your school or college with questions.
Find your rep →
3
Apply
Submit our quick, secure online application, then send transcripts and any required test scores.
Start application →
4
Track
Monitor outstanding requirements in your Status Portal. Your decision letter will be posted there too.
ⓘ
How admissions decisions are made
Admission into a graduate program at the University of Miami is selective and determined by each individual department or program. The Graduate School facilitates the application process and serves as a liaison between you and the program you are applying to, but is not involved in admissions decisions.
General Application Procedures
Everything you need to know, step by step. Select a topic to expand it.
💻 Online Application
Apply online to most* on-campus graduate programs at the University of Miami. Our online application is quick, secure, and convenient.
After you submit, you will be directed to your Status Portal, where you can monitor your application and view any outstanding requirements. When your admission decision is released, your decision letter will be posted there.
Within 48 to 72 hours of submitting, you will receive an email with your University of Miami credentials and instructions for creating a password. Use these credentials to log in to University systems such as your Status Portal and Financial Aid Portal. Returning users who already have a CaneID should use their existing credentials.
*Programs that use other application methods are listed under "Program Specific Application Procedures" below.
📄 Transcripts
Transcripts must be submitted directly to the University of Miami or to the program you applied to. If sending transcripts via Parchment, select "University of Miami - Graduate School."
For additional details, contact the admissions representative for your program.
✏️ Exam Scores
If your program requires an entrance exam, submit official score reports (GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo English Test, etc.) to the University of Miami.

Cards accepted: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover.
Your card information is secure. The Graduate School never has access to your credit card information. It is used only to process your application fee and is transmitted through, but not stored on, a web-enabled server. See the University of Miami Privacy Policy.
Refunds are at the discretion of each program. Contact your admissions representative for information or to request a refund.
